newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-HINGIS PULLS OUT OF GERMAN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HINGIS PULLS OUT OF GERMAN OPEN.

text.p: World number one Martina Hingis has pulled out of the German Open in Berlin next week, dashing hopes of a showdown with her predecessor Steffi Graf.
Hingis' manager Damir Keretic said on Tuesday an operation on the Swiss player's knee could also force her out of the French Open starting on May 26.
The 16-year-old suffered a slight tear of a knee ligament in a riding accident near her Swiss home late last month.
Graf, who lost the number one ranking to Hingis in March, is expected to make a return to competitive tennis after an injury lay-off of more than three months at the $926,000 German Open.
The Berlin organisers also said France's Mary Pierce had asked for a wild card.
